description: This file contains functions for analyzing user skills and roles, generating gap analysis and roadmaps, and defining related data structures for a career navigation platform.

classes.name: GapAnalysisInput
classes.description: Input schema for gap analysis, including current and target role IDs.

classes.name: GapAnalysisOutput
classes.description: Output schema for gap analysis, including strengths, gaps, and recommendations.

classes.name: SkillItem
classes.description: Represents a skill with its ID, name, and required level.

classes.name: RoadmapInput
classes.description: Input schema for building a skill development roadmap, including gaps.

classes.name: RoadmapOutput
classes.description: Output schema for the roadmap, including nodes and edges for visualization.

classes.name: CytoscapeElement
classes.description: Represents a node or edge in a Cytoscape graph visualization.

methods.name: _role_required_skill_map
methods.description: Retrieves skills and their required levels for a specific role.

methods.name: _user_skill_level
methods.description: Gets the current user's level for a specific skill.

methods.name: compute_gap_analysis
methods.description: Calculates skill gaps and strengths between current user role and target role.

methods.name: build_roadmap
methods.description: Creates a visual roadmap of skills needed to bridge gaps between current and target skills.
